newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France cancels several May 21 cargo freighters.
newsitem.headline: Air France cancels several May 21 cargo freighters.

text.p: Air France Cargo said it had cancelled several Boeing 747-200 freighter flights scheduled to leave Paris on Wednesday, May 21 due to a four-day pilot strike which began today.

"As we speak, four to five 747F flights scheduled to leave Paris tomorrow have been cancelled and include those stopping over or terminating in Toronto, Chicago, the French West Indies, Bogota, Abu Dhabi and Delhi," an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.

"We can confirm that two 747F flights are being maintained tomorrow, a code-shared flight with Japan Airlines to Tokyo/Narita and a Paris-New York-Mexico City-Los Angeles service but beyond that we cannot say as the situation is prone to change."

Another Air France cargo official told Reuters the only 747F flight the airline had cancelled today, May 20, because of the strike, was a Paris-Hong Kong service via Dubai scheduled to leave this evening.
The strike is a resumption of a walkout threatened last month after talks with management broke down over a pay scale which would pay pilots 15 percent less than current crews.

Around 50 percent of Air France's short and medium-haul were hit by the strike but long-haul passenger flights were unaffected by the strike, an airline spokeswoman added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
